'''Koru Tama''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] aide to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Evran]], Republic diplomat on [[Voss]]. When the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Havoc Squad Major]] arrived to accomplish several military objectives for Evran, Koru Tama provided him with additional objectives, such as recovering Voss artifacts and destroying [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] snipers.
